name: Force Die
description:
Let’s talk about the Force Die. If your character is Force-sensitive, or uses the Devotant asset and chooses the Force as a source of power/worship, there are times when the power of the Force will hold sway over your story. When you would roll to Ask the Oracle, you may sometimes roll the Force Die—a third d10— along with the other two d10s. (Use a different color d10 to make sure the Force Die stands out.) If the Force Die lands on 10 (usually signified by a 0 or 00 on a d10), the result is affected by the Force, and you should check the Force Die Oracle on the next page.

The results of the Force Die Oracle may require more rolls on other Oracle tables, to fully discern the will of the Force. Also, the entries on the Force Die Oracle that are in italics and with exclamation mark (such as Torrent of Fear!) signified a strong, intense emotion to go along with it.
